evidence_quotes.O: I like its compact size, elegant design, and, almost more than anything else, the feel of its keys while typing.
evidence_quotes.C: As I had anticipated, the GPS unit and the dashboard mount had not moved at all from their location for the duration of the trip.
evidence_quotes.E: We just came back from a thousand mile (each way) road trip.
evidence_quotes.A: If you are looking for a very light accessory for your iPad Mini then this case is not for you.
evidence_quotes.N: The user-instruction sheet is very poorly written and not very clear on a couple of crucial steps of the set up.
